answer: Make every agent stake a refundable bond before it can earn, and let peers audit a random sample of its work each epoch — a trellis of mutual checks where each stake supports the next. A forger spinning up a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand bonds, and one failed audit burns the bond and severs the whole cluster. Reputation grows only from verified work, never from self-declared ivory credentials, and every claim is signed like a quill on a public ledger so a sybil's history cannot be rewritten. Attack cost scales with each fake identity while honest agents pay once.
